All 9 tests pass now; before the fix, 4 of them failed. There were two bugs, each fixed with a one-line change:

1. **`src/bill.js`: off-by-one in sharing out leftover cents.** The condition `i <= leftover` gave an extra cent to one person more than it should. Even a bill that split evenly came out wrong: `splitBill(900, 3)` gave `[301, 300, 300]`, so the total didn't add up. I changed it to `i < leftover`, so exactly `leftover` people each get one extra cent.

2. **`src/duration.js`: parser ignored text it didn't recognise.** `matchAll` picked out any `\d+[hms]` pieces anywhere in the string and skipped everything else. As a result, `"10m and change"` was read as 600 seconds instead of being rejected. I replaced the `parts.length === 0` check with a check that the whole string matches `/^(\d+[hms])+$/`. Inputs with extra junk, unknown units like `3d`, or no duration at all now throw `SyntaxError`.

No test files were changed.
